title: No invoice line or scan lookup exists that could offer an inactive part
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an inactive part, part A.
  • Create an invoiced work order, work order 1, for this test, whose line, line 1, sold an active part, part B.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Finance tab.
  2. Click the Lines tab.
  3. Click Add Part under line 1.
  4. Click the X at the top right of the window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1's invoice shows part B on its line, and it offers no part lookup of its own on its lines: ShopView has no invoice-line part lookup.

Step 2:

  • The Lines tab shows line 1.

Step 3:

  • The New Part Request window opens with its Part Number lookup, and there is no barcode or scan button beside it: ShopView has no scan lookup.

Step 4:

  • The window closes and line 1 is unchanged.

If this build does have an invoice-line part lookup or a scan button, type part A's part number in it: part A must not be offered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-R4: “If ShopView adds a part lookup to an invoice line outside a work order or part sale, that lookup does not return inactive parts.”
  • S9-R7: “If ShopView adds a barcode or scan part lookup, that lookup does not return inactive parts.”
  • Story 9, context note: “Context note: S9-R4 and S9-R7 describe screens ShopView does not have. They are kept so that any future lookup of that kind follows the same rule.”
